latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Automatic cloud-powered video editing and export skill.

- Upload raw video footage and receive auto-edited, polished videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; files up to 500MB).
- Instantly remove silences, add transitions, sync background music, and more—no manual editing needed.
- User-friendly workflow: upload, describe edits, and get downloadable 1080p MP4 output in 1–2 minutes.
- Connects via user token or free starter credits (no local setup required).
- Real-time session and editing updates, with full support for batch and iterative workflows.
- Provides status, credits checking, export, and session management directly in chat.
